verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents payments webhooks that let an application track order lifecycle events and payment status, so a backend can receive pushed order events. However, the Agent Checkouts product explicitly ships with "no webhooks in v1" and requires polling, so an agent-driven purchase flow cannot subscribe to pushed events. missing for 10: an enumerated event catalog (created/updated/fulfilled/canceled), webhook push for agent checkouts, documentation of payload, retry and signature details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent or backend can subscribe to order lifecycle events — created, updated, fulfilled, canceled — pushed programmatically

citations.quote: Webhooks allow you to track the status of payments and order lifecycle events in your application.
Track order lifecycle events and payment status with webhooks
